paragraphs: Skopenow sells a suite of online research and security products to qualified organizations, which use them to generate intelligence reports on entities for fraud, threat, crime and due diligence work. Its home page names global security teams, loss prevention teams and executive protection teams as the groups it serves. The company also says it has partnered with Fortune 500 companies, large government and law enforcement agencies, the largest insurance carriers and media outlets.

The platform fuses crime data, consumer records, news, media and other data points to surface emerging threats, fraud, connections and criminal activity. It is sold as five products: Grid, Pre-Check, Workbench, Link Analysis and Rabbit. Link Analysis maps the networks between entities as a visual graph. Its situational awareness tools give security teams a single dashboard that fuses media, traffic cams, crime, news, satellite imagery and message boards in real time. Dozens of purpose-built models sift the collected data for case-relevant fraud and threat signals. The product is free to try and includes the core features.

Skopenow was built in 2015 to help organizations understand internet data. It is a Techstars company whose investors include Runway VP and Barbara Corcoran. It reports working with over 1,500 customers from around the world. The company hosts free monthly virtual trainings for OSINT professionals.

quote.text: Skopenow provides a single, automated platform to streamline investigations and enable organizations to make more informed decisions.
